units.T1: port 1 power as a fraction of the input (port 2 = 1 - T1, lossless)
units.P: power in the top waveguide (bottom = 1 - top)

paper.axes: y: frame lines at 1e-1 (row 55) and 1e-6 (row 343); x: labels 0-300 at 137.5-635.5 px

retime.rule: c(p): the model iteration shown at displayed iteration p, monotone (dynamic programming), whose port 1 at 1470 nm and whose spectrum are closest to the paper's (Fig. 3d/3g as digitized), ending at model iteration 300

paper_taper.units: r: trainable width / fixed end width (450 nm); L_um: taper length

paper_spectra.units: T1: port 1 transmission x 10000 (uint16, little-endian, base64), iteration-major: p * 101 + k, p = 0..300, k over lams_nm; port 2 = 1 - T1
paper_spectra.scale: heatmap colorbar ends read as 18.4% and 81.3% (fitted to Fig. 3g), not 0 and 100%
paper_spectra.anchors: Fig. 3g at iterations 0, 50, 300; iterations 50-60: Fig. 3g at 50 to the heatmap's right part at 60
